listed_sector_signals.quote:
Additionally, future
research should explore alternative energy recovery technologies such
as gasification, pyrolysis, and biohydrogen production from wastewater
and sludge.

other_continuous_flow_signals.signal: Both case-study wastewater treatment plants operate at full capacity year-round.
other_continuous_flow_signals.quote:
Two WWTPs, Molina de Segura and Alcantarilla are selected for this

year-around,

other_continuous_flow_signals.signal: Molina de Segura processes a quantified daily flow of domestic and industrial wastewater.
other_continuous_flow_signals.quote:
It serves approximately 291,666 people equivalent
(PE) and treats about 25,000 m3/d of wastewater from both domestic
and industrial sources.

other_continuous_flow_signals.signal: Anaerobic digestion recovers biogas from sludge and supplies electricity at Alcantarilla.
other_continuous_flow_signals.quote:
anaerobic digestion to recover biogas, which supplies about
35 % of the facility’s annual electricity demand.

other_continuous_flow_signals.signal: Molina de Segura uses sludge-derived biogas in an existing CHP system.
other_continuous_flow_signals.quote:
anaerobic digestion (AD) coupled with a combined heat and
power (CHP) unit.

other_continuous_flow_signals.signal: Hydropower is explicitly described as continuous generation within the wastewater hydraulic-energy recovery assessment.
other_continuous_flow_signals.quote:
Unlike solar, hydropower can produce continuous energy
with higher efficiencies (70–90 %) and a capacity factor above 50 %
(British Hydropower Association, 2012).

other_continuous_flow_signals.signal: A cited study addresses power-to-gas integration with wastewater treatment and biogas; this is reference-only evidence.
other_continuous_flow_signals.quote:
Optimising power-to-gas
integration with wastewater treatment and biogas: a techno-economic assessment of
CO2 and by-product utilisation.

one_line: The paper applies energy assessment and techno-economic decarbonisation analysis to two year-round wastewater treatment plants in Murcia, including biogas CHP, solar PV and hydraulic energy recovery.
